regras.titulo: The rules of Alumia, in four sentences
pontos: The conversation is about study and struggle: respect people who think differently, criticize ideas and never persons.
Nobody appears with their real name: only the pseudonym, not even the team.
There is no private chat. No home address, phone number or document in posts.
Whoever reports is never revealed. Every moderation decision has a rule, a reason and the right to appeal.

consentimento.texto: Talking about politics and struggle can reveal your political opinion or trade union membership. The law treats this as sensitive personal data (LGPD, art. 5, II).
consentimento.finalidade: We use it only to show what you write to whom you choose and for moderation to look after the conversation. We do not sell it, build commercial profiles or track what you read.
consentimento.revogar: You can withdraw consent at any time and ask for your data to be deleted (LGPD, art. 18). The version of the rules in force is recorded.
consentimento.caixa: I consent, specifically and prominently, to the processing of the sensitive data I may reveal by taking part in Alumia, for this purpose (LGPD, art. 11, I).
consentimento.base: Without this consent you keep the rest of the site; you just do not join Alumia.

idade.titulo: Alumia is only for people over 18
idade.texto: We do not process data of children and teenagers in Alumia (LGPD, art. 14). This is your own declaration; the rest of the site stays open to all ages.
idade.negada: That is fine: Alumia is only for people over 18. The rest of the site remains open to you.

codinome.texto: It is the name everyone will see. Do not use your real name or someone else's name.

escolhas.texto: This builds your feed and joins you to the related open communities. You can change it any time in Explore.
escolhas.lutasVazio: There are no open struggle communities yet. Go ahead.
escolhas.trilhasFalha: Could not list the tracks right now.
escolhas.aparecer: I agree to appear in people packs to follow (only if my profile is open). You can turn it off any time.

cartoes.texto: Do not say where you live, where you work or who you live with. Not even the team sees your real name in Alumia.
Home address, phone, ID number and e-mail stay out of posts. For calls to action use a public place: square, library, union hall.
The Report button is on every post. You follow progress in Notices and nobody learns who reported.
The Quick exit button opens a neutral page and erases what Alumia kept on this device. Use it when you need to.

ordens.semAlgoritmo: There is no hidden score: the order is only the rule below. No order uses reading time, clicks or what you liked.
ordens.teto: Each order shows at most 100 posts, and the list ends there. To go further, refine by tag, community or search.

novos.formula: From newest to oldest. Nothing else.

uteis.formula: How many people marked Useful, highest first. Tie: the newest. Only posts from the last 30 days.

sem_resposta.formula: Posts with no reply you can see and no accepted answer, newest first. Only the last 30 days.

em_debate.formula: How many replies the conversation got in the last 7 days (only those you can see), highest first. Tie: the newest. Only posts from the last 30 days.

relevancia.formula: How well the post text matches your search (Postgres ts_rank_cd, Portuguese, accent-free). Tie: the newest.

tag.vazio: There are no posts with this hashtag that you can see yet.

explorar.lead: Discover communities, theme lines and current conversations. Everything with a written rule, no hidden algorithm.
explorar.linhasAjuda: Each line shows the posts that follow a public rule.
explorar.tagsAjuda: Hashtags used by 3 or more different people in the last 7 days, only from posts you can see.
explorar.pacotesAjuda: Packs chosen by the team. Only people with an open profile who agreed to appear are included.
explorar.pacotesVazio: There are no people packs yet.
explorar.abrirPacote: See who is in the pack
explorar.aparecerAjuda: If on, the team may include your open profile in people packs to follow. If off, nobody includes you.
explorar.aparecerDesligar: I do not want to appear

buscar.dica: Works without accents and with plurals: strike finds strikes. Use quotes for a phrase and - to exclude a word.
buscar.vazio: Nothing found that you can see.
buscar.soComuns: Only very common words: try more specific terms.
buscar.visitante: Without an account, search shows only what is open to the internet.
